description: [PAID $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Given a transaction hash, lists the ERC-20 transfers in its receipt and, if you give expectations (payee, asset, amount, payer), says whether a successful transaction contains a matching transfer. Use it to check an x402 or other USDC payment. A match proves tokens moved; it does not prove what the payment was for.

asset.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

chain.description: EVM CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453, or a bare chain id number as a string. Chain names are refused.

payTo.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

payer.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

name: payment_verify
title: Verify a token payment from a receipt
